name: Atlantis (STS-129)
about: Atlantis (STS-129) (2009-062A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2009 Nov 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2009 Nov 24), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
